title: 第23章 十三年的流言蜚语第24章 十三年多第一次开口说话
content_zh:
时间飞快，三天时间，姬云生除了晚上和陈晓云回去睡觉，早晨就会来到洛冰儿这里，跟着她学习修炼知识。这三天的时间，青玉宗也知道洛冰儿收了个弟子，都是议论纷纷。毕竟洛冰儿这么多年以来，也才收了两个弟子，这次居然又收了个弟子，
所以每个青玉宗的人都十分好奇。第一天还好，议论声没有多少，第二天，宗门上下都震惊了，被收的弟子居然还是个男的，虽然只是半岁年纪，但也足够宗门上下八卦纷飞了。第三天时，姬云生跟着洛冰儿学习，修炼速度快的都让洛冰儿三女给吓了一跳。
因为三天时间的修炼，姬云生居然修炼到炼气九重圆满了。这消息也在第四天传出，青玉宗上下更加议论纷纷了，毕竟如此天骄居然出现在他们眼前，实在是让人不敢置信。要是说知道姬云生年纪，和他们相仿还好，但他才半岁年纪啊！
第四天时，姬云生脑海之中，一个神秘的美丽女子见状说道：“你这臭小子，之前那么骂我，看我不先给你点好看，也让你知道，以后还敢不敢对我不敬了。”然后随着女子手中一道能量释放，姬云生的修为顿时被封住了，还是那种无论他如何，都不能提升一丝力量，只能止步于炼气九重圆满境界了。
当然这事姬云生本人也不知道，本来这种天骄出现在青玉宗是件幸事，可惜天不遂愿。时间一天天过去，姬云生和三女起初还以为，自己是修炼速度过快，才不能继续突破境界了。四人起初也就没有在意，直到一个月、两个月、半年、一年后，
姬云生还是提升不了一点境界。四人才发觉不对劲，洛冰儿又传给他一本灵级极品功法，姬云生也很快就掌握了，可惜的是，他的修为还是止步于此。又过去一个月，姬云生心里骂道：“卧槽，什么情况，这一年多来，我怎么提升不了一点修为了啊？”
姬云生修为止步炼气九重后，这事也瞒不住其他人，慢慢的在青玉宗流传。这个让人之前人人羡慕的天骄，也跌落下神坛，慢慢被众人议论，而议论内容都是各种鄙视。时间一年年过去，姬云生也习惯了流言蜚语，时不时的老是在宗门的一座山峰发呆，
也是因为这里的风景不错。虽然这里也有很多人来此，但谁也不知道他在想什么。时间匆匆，进入青玉宗的日子，也缓缓过去十三年时光，虽然宗门之人议论他，但也不敢在他面前议论，都只是偷偷摸摸的私下议论。毕竟他们可是知道，即使姬云生没有修炼下去的机会了，
但众人也不敢当着他的面议论他。毕竟十三年时间以来，当着他面议论他说：“你们看，这哑巴天骄，老是来这里发呆，这是真放弃了？真是笑死老子了，就这样的一辈子炼气九重，老子一只手都可以灭一堆。”也有人说：“亏我还以为宗门出了这么一个天骄，
以后日子会更加好了，结果呢？如今青玉宗都成元阳王朝笑柄了，要不是有寒冰长老他们护着，我真想杀了这小子。”也有人说道：“要是我知道我有如此结果，我可不好意思呆在宗门了。”各种嘲讽声，姬云生都听了不知道多少，而且对方嘲讽他，他也不理对方，
所以慢慢的，他就成了很多人不满了。可惜的是，这种情况直到第五年的时候，嘲讽声才少了很多，虽然也有，但是没有一个人敢当面嘲讽了。毕竟五年以来，当着他面嘲讽他的人，都是一具具尸体，不乏在宗门是长老之位。虽然姬云生也不在意人家如此嘲讽，
以他的话来说就是：“嘲讽怎么了？难道不是事实吗？人家的嘴长在人家身上，我又管不了。”陈晓云和李雨彤两女倒是还好，见到如此的情况，她们也只是把这些人废了。可在洛冰儿这里，就算是被两女废的人，她都是悄悄直接杀了。
两女也询问过，只是洛冰儿都是回答道：“死人才不会带来麻烦，单单废了他算什么？难道给自己以后添麻烦吗？万一对方记恨，又遇到大机缘的话，修为快速上升超过自己，来报仇的话那时候要怎么办？”两女听多了后，也纷纷觉得有道理，也就不再询问了，
也和洛冰儿一样，只要被她们发现当着姬云生面嘲讽的，都是直接杀了，打不过的又让洛冰儿动手。姬云生也看惯了，毕竟他也没有办法管三女，三人都是修为比他高。不单单是劝了也没有用，三女根本就不赞同，姬云生劝过几次之后，也就没有继续劝了。
毕竟三女表面同意，结果呢？只是不当着他的面杀了对方，这样的劝解有什么用呢？
content_en:
Time flies so fast. In three days, apart from going back to sleep with Chen Xiaoyun at night, Ji Yunsheng will come to Luo Bing'er in the morning to learn cultivation knowledge from her. In the past three days, the Qingyu Sect also knew that Luo Bing'er had accepted a disciple, and everyone was talking about it. After all, Luo Bing'er has only accepted two disciples in so many years, and this time she actually accepted another disciple.
So everyone in the Qingyu Sect is very curious. The first day was fine, there wasn't much discussion, but on the second day, everyone in the sect was shocked. The disciple who was accepted was actually a man. Although he was only half a year old, it was enough to cause a lot of gossip in the sect. On the third day, Ji Yunsheng studied with Luo Bing'er, and the speed of training shocked the three Luo Bing'er girls.
Because of three days of practice, Ji Yunsheng actually reached the ninth level of Qi Refining. This news also came out on the fourth day, and everyone in the Qingyu Sect was talking even more. After all, it was really unbelievable that such a talented person actually appeared in front of them. If you knew Ji Yunsheng's age, it would be fine if he was similar to them, but he is only half a year old!
On the fourth day, in Ji Yunsheng's mind, a mysterious and beautiful woman saw this and said: "You stinky boy, you scolded me like that before, don't I give you some good looks first, and let you know, don't you dare to be disrespectful to me in the future." Then with the release of energy in the woman's hand, Ji Yunsheng's cultivation level was suddenly sealed, and it was still the kind that no matter what he did, he could not increase his power at all, and could only stop at the ninth level of Qi Refining.
Of course, Ji Yunsheng himself didn't know this. Originally, it was a blessing for such a genius to appear in the Qingyu Sect, but it was a pity that God did not have his wish. Time passed day by day, and Ji Yunsheng and the three women thought at first that they were practicing too fast and could not continue to break through the realm. The four of them didn't pay attention at first, until one month, two months, half a year, and one year later,
Ji Yunsheng still couldn't improve his level a little bit. Only then did the four of them realize that something was wrong. Luo Bing'er gave him another top-notch spiritual-level technique, and Ji Yunsheng quickly mastered it. Unfortunately, his cultivation stopped there. Another month passed, and Ji Yunsheng cursed in his heart: "What the hell, why can't I improve my cultivation level in the past year or so?"
After Ji Yunsheng reached the ninth level of Qi Refining, he could no longer hide this from others, and it slowly spread in the Qingyu Sect. This genius, who was envied by everyone before, also fell off the altar and was slowly discussed by everyone, and the content of the discussion was all kinds of contempt. Years passed, and Ji Yunsheng became accustomed to rumors. From time to time, he would always be in a daze on a mountain peak of the sect.
It's also because the scenery here is nice. Although there are many people here, no one knows what he is thinking. Time flies, and thirteen years have passed since he entered the Qingyu Sect. Although the people in the sect talked about him, they did not dare to talk in front of him, and they only discussed it secretly and privately. After all, they knew that even if Ji Yunsheng had no chance to continue practicing,
But no one dared to talk about him in front of him. After all, for the past thirteen years, they have talked about him in front of him and said: "Look, this mute genius always comes here to be in a daze. Has he really given up? It really makes me laugh to death. After spending my whole life at the ninth level of Qi refining, I can destroy a bunch of people with one hand." Some people said: "It's a shame that I thought the sect had such a genius.
Things will get better in the future, but what’s the result? Now the Qingyu Sect has become the laughingstock of the Yuanyang Dynasty. If it weren't for Elder Hanbing and the others protecting him, I would really want to kill this kid. "Some people also said: "If I knew that I would have such a result, I would be embarrassed to stay in the sect. "Ji Yunsheng heard all kinds of taunts, and he didn't pay attention to them when they taunted him.
So slowly, many people became dissatisfied with him. It is a pity that this situation did not become much less sarcastic until the fifth year. Although there were still some,No one dared to ridicule him face to face. After all, the people who had mocked him in front of him in the past five years were all corpses, and many of them were elders in the sect. Although Ji Yunsheng doesn't care about others' ridicule,
In his words: "What happened to the ridicule? Isn't it true? I can't control other people's mouths." Chen Xiaoyun and Li Yutong were fine. Seeing such a situation, they just destroyed these people. But in Luo Bing'er's case, even those who were abandoned by the two women would be killed quietly and directly by her.
The two women also asked, but Luo Bing'er always replied: "A dead person won't cause trouble, so what's the point of just deposing him? Will it cause trouble for yourself in the future? What if the other party holds a grudge and encounters a great opportunity, and his cultivation level quickly rises to surpass his own, and he comes to take revenge?" After hearing more, the two women felt that it made sense, and stopped asking.
Just like Luo Bing'er, anyone they found taunting Ji Yun in front of him would be killed directly, and those who couldn't be beaten would have Luo Bing'er take action. Ji Yunsheng was used to it. After all, he had no way to control the three women. All three of them were higher in cultivation than him. Not only was the persuasion useless, the three women did not agree at all. After Ji Yunsheng tried to persuade her several times, she stopped persuading him.
After all, the three women agreed on the surface, but what was the result? Just don't kill the other party in front of him. What's the use of such persuasion?
